description: arranges content in a horizontally scrollable row with a configurable scrollbar.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gap between items, using --tp-slider-gap when absent.

attributes.name: item-width
attributes.description: Preferred width of non-image items. By default, each item uses its own width or content-based size.

attributes.name: scrollback-thumb-color
attributes.description: Scrollbar thumb color, using --tp-scrollbar-thumb-color when absent. Defaults to the theme's neutral scrollbar color.

attributes.name: scrollbar
attributes.description: Shows the scrollbar when present and hides it when absent, regardless of the attribute's text value.

attributes.name: scrollbar-track-color
attributes.description: Scrollbar track color, using --tp-scrollbar-track-color when absent.

attributes.name: slider-height
attributes.description: Height of the scrolling area. By default, follows the content height.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-slider>` element implements the <tp-icon name="slider" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Slider functionality: arranges content in a horizontally scrollable row with a configurable scrollbar.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Horizontal scrolling | Scroll to reveal items outside the visible area. |
| Links and controls | Use embedded items normally. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves focus to the slider, then to its focusable children. |
| ArrowLeft / ArrowRight | Scrolls the focused slider left or right by 80% of its visible width. |
| Home / End | Scrolls the focused slider to the start or end of its content, respecting text direction. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
